name: @akaanakbaik/pterodactyl-gateway
description: Gateway Pterodactyl profesional untuk JavaScript dan TypeScript: Application API, Client API, perencanaan kapasitas, WebSocket, backup, email, dan CLI.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsup src/index.ts src/cli-entry.ts src/wizard-cli.ts --format esm,cjs --sourcemap --target node18 --out-dir dist --external ws --external nodemailer && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/emit-cjs-types.mjs && npm run chmod:bin
scripts.chmod:bin: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['dist/cli-entry.js','dist/wizard-cli.js']) if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.chmodSync(f, 0o755)"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:cli: npm run build && node dist/cli-entry.js help && node dist/cli-entry.js version --json && node dist/cli-entry.js self-check --json && node dist/cli-entry.js release-check --json
scripts.ci: npm run verify && npm run security:audit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:source && npm test && npm run test:types && npm run test:cli && npm run test:pack && npm run test:release
scripts.publish:dry: npm run verify && npm publish --dry-run --access public

author: akaanakbaik
